(async()=>{const p=await import('/src/studio/assistant/provider.ts'),t=await import('/src/studio/assistant/transport.ts'),s=await import('/src/studio/assistant/session.ts');p.useAssistantProvider.getState().setProvider('minimax');const calls=[],original=window.fetch;window.fetch=async(url,init)=>{calls.push(String(url));const body=JSON.parse(init.body);return new Response(JSON.stringify({requestId:body.requestId,content:{role:'model',parts:[{text:'Transport fixture'}]},sources:[],model:'MiniMax-M2.5'}),{status:200})};const errors=[];try{for(const name of ['web_search','generate_render_visualisation']){let refused=false;try{await s.callAssistantTool(name,{query:'Search fixture'},AbortSignal.timeout(10000))}catch(e){errors.push(e.message);refused=e.message.includes('No Gemini request was sent')}if(!refused)throw Error('Tool not refused '+name)}const req={schema:'xray.assistant-request/v1',requestId:crypto.randomUUID(),contents:[{role:'user',parts:[{text:'Fixture'}]}],declarations:[],webSearch:true};try{await t.assistantTurn(req,AbortSignal.timeout(10000),'minimax');throw Error('Search unexpectedly allowed')}catch(e){if(!e.message.includes('No Gemini request was sent'))throw e;errors.push(e.message)}if(calls.length)throw Error('Unavailable capability sent a request');p.useAssistantProvider.getState().setProvider('gemini');await t.assistantTurn({...req,webSearch:false},AbortSignal.timeout(10000),'minimax');if(calls.length!==1||calls[0]!=='/api/minimax-ai')throw Error('Pinned provider changed');}finally{window.fetch=original;p.useAssistantProvider.getState().setProvider('minimax')}return {requests:calls,errors,pinnedProviderVerified:true,selected:p.useAssistantProvider.getState().provider}})()
